responsibility: Provides the i386 backend’s instruction scheduling model for AMD Zen 4 (znver4). This machine-description file defines the znver4 DFA automata, decode classifications, integer/branch, AGU, divider, floating-point, and FP-store pipeline resources, then assigns detailed reservation and latency data to scalar integer, memory, SSE/AVX/AVX-512, mask, and conversion instruction classes based on attributes such as type, mode, memory access, and EVEX prefixing. GCC’s scheduler consumes these reservations to estimate issue width, resource conflicts, and throughput for znver4 specifically, distinguishing it from the earlier shared Zen 1–3 model in znver.md.
